document.title: Young people moving to big cities
document.question:
In many countries, young people are leaving villages and small towns to live in large cities. Some see this as a natural part of development, while others fear that rural areas will be left behind.

Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
